text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, Valentine's Day is coming up soon, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
do you like sweets?
One February afternoon, we were chatting about such things between meetings.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion!
I have brought a delivery for you...!
choice_data_list: A gift...? I wonder what it could be.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's truly magnificent.
Here we go, believe it or not—it's this!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"It's an invitation to that famous
GI race held in Dubai...!"

—A pinnacle international GⅠ where the world's finest gather.
A 2000m race held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Receiving an invitation to this race means being recognized
as having the highest caliber of ability
among Japanese Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "If I recall, it's a race that no Japanese Umamusume has ever won before..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

The first conquest in the history of Japanese Umamusume.
It's not hard to imagine the sheer magnitude of what will come from such a triumph.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: By running in the Dubai races, wouldn't we be able to connect the entire world?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Races create inspiration and hope.
Until now, we have connected these bonds
locally and within the country."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps we might be able to make that circle just a little bit bigger."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There are surely many people all over the world
who are lonely or have fallen out of the fold.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...The world is a vast place. It must be difficult to forge such strong bonds so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However—perhaps I can take that very first step in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: First a single step, gradually growing wider—words are unnecessary in a race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If we keep stacking up touching, passionate races,
surely, one day, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I am certain we can cross borders and connect hearts across the world.

—I can't say it's impossible.
However, it is a vast, monumental dream.
choice_data_list: (But—she's always seen it through to the end.)

text_block_list.text:
The bonds they forged possessed undeniable power,
changing hearts and inspiring action.

If it's her, she can surely turn
any dream into reality.
choice_data_list: ――Yeah, if it's you, you can pull it off.
—Yeah, if it's you, you can do it.

text_block_list.text:
All I can do—
as a Trainer, is chart a path on the map.

There is no concrete plan yet.
There is much to do, and it will be grueling.
—Even so, regardless of all that.

If it's her, she truly can
connect the world and banish all loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truly...
you are such a warm person.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Please let me go...! To spin hope for the world—

And so, another brand-new dream
descended gently upon her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So, to sum it up...
After the Dubai expedition, it's off to Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And after that—
it's on to France's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?
Succeed in Dubai, then travel around the world. That was the plan we made together to connect the world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And our return to Japan will be roughly this autumn.
All to challenge the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Yes,
I suppose that should about do it...!

It's a slightly demanding rotation, but with her stamina,
she should be able to handle it without trouble.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together, Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's run through it... together!
—A few days later. On my way back from training, Victoire Pisa called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have prepared a Valentine's gift for you.
Would you please accept it?

I receive a neatly wrapped red box that feels
just a bit heavier than its appearance suggests.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad you were there with me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with a grand dream, you never back down
and help me so positively—you have no idea
how much of a support you are to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I am grateful. From the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, let us run together.
And let us connect the world.
Upon returning home, I opened the present right away.
"Inside... was a row of kohakuto candies, sparkling like precious jewels."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Well then, see you tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“...May I add one small thing
regarding the gift?”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The gift I gave you is kohakuto,
crafted to look like sparkling jewels.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Like light piercing through a clear sea,
I made a beautiful gemstone—an apatite."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Praying for the success of this world-connecting journey.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hoping that our bonds will make us stronger.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Please, enjoy your meal♪

Upon returning home, I opened the present right away.
Light blue kohakuto candies were neatly lined up in a row—
The refined sweetness gently soothed my tired body after a long day.
